title: Hotel California
hook: Why Hotel California feels like *you can't leave*
cover_text: The chord that *won't let you leave*

chords.name: F#
chords.text: Should be minor. Going major adds *A♯*, a hook back to B.

chords.name: A
chords.text: Then it starts *sinking*, one step at a time.

chords.name: E
chords.text: *E major*: its G♯ is a flash of light in a dark key.

chords.name: G
chords.text: Down again to *G*. The light fades.

chords.name: D
chords.text: *D major*, the warmest chord yet. A way out?

chords.name: Em
chords.text: No. *E minor* takes the light back.

chords.name: F#
chords.text: F♯ again. *A♯ pulls* you back toward B…
